verdict.rationale: Claude's first-party Research feature operates agentically, running multiple searches that build on each other, and returns thorough answers with easy-to-check citations. That covers the core of an autonomous, cited deep research run. One community user finds the research depth weaker than competitors, which is a quality opinion rather than evidence the feature fails. Missing for 10: documentation of how many or what kinds of sources are searched, explicit long-form report output (the docs say 'answers'), and independent hands-on corroboration of citation quality.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can launch a deep research run that autonomously searches many sources and returns a cited report

citations.quote: Claude operates agentically, conducting multiple searches that build on each other while determining exactly what to investigate next.
With research, Claude delivers thorough answers in minutes, complete with easy-to-check citations so you can trust Claude's findings.
Works pretty nicely for research still
